profile.headline: Marketing & Information Systems student · Social media, video, and SEO content
profile.summary: Marketing and Information Systems & Business Analytics student at Loyola Marymount University (May 2027), with hands-on experience leading social media for The Loyolan, producing short-form video, and creating SEO-focused content for XDR Radiology.

experience.description: Conducted competitive and digital marketing research across dental technology brands to identify opportunities to differentiate XDR’s messaging and improve content strategy. Analyzed social media and website performance metrics to identify opportunities to improve SEO, engagement, and lead generation. Built marketing automation workflows to streamline newsletter research and SEO recommendations. Created product marketing videos and promotional content for XDR’s product portfolio. Researched and wrote SEO-focused blog content to strengthen XDR’s organic search presence and provide educational resources for dental professionals. Managed and updated website content and pages to improve clarity and design, as well as support lead generation.

experience.company_name: Loyola Marymount University, The Loyolan Newspaper
experience.description: Lead and manage a team at LMU’s newspaper to manage the various social media accounts (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok) and create engaging content. Pitch ideas and oversee the production of creative content. Collaborate with other sections within the newsroom, such as Opinion, Sports, and News to ensure content aligns with upcoming articles. Produce and edit short-form videos including on-the-street interviews and event coverage to draw more traffic to the website. Collaborate with other sections such as Photo, Opinion, and Sports to create short-form videos that complement upcoming articles or photo essays. Manage daily content posting and analyze social media reports. Host a weekly event, “What’s Up Wednesdays,” conducting interviews with students on relevant topics on campus or in the greater LA community.

education.details: M-School Program – specialized track in modern digital storytelling and creative marketing. Cumulative GPA 3.84. Dean’s List, Ignatius Grant, Xavier Award.
